title: A Note on the Resolvent Algebra and Functional Integral Approach to the Free Bose Einstein Condensation
summary: We present a systematic description of the structure of Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC) in the free Bose gas from the viewpoint of the correspondence between the operator-algebraic formulation based on the resolvent algebra and the functional integral representation.
